title.narrative: Support to the Amazon Fund, results 2017-2018

description.narrative: Support to the Amazon Fund in BNDES for reduction of greenhouse gas emissions from deforestation and forest degradation in Brazil from achieved results in 2017 and 2018. The Fund contributes to the climate adaptation agenda by supporting initiatives that promote socio-environmental resilience in the Legal Amazon. Key actions include the restoration of degraded areas, strengthening environmental monitoring and control systems, and fostering sustainable productive activities that integrate local communities while preserving ecosystems. The Amazon Fund prioritizes structural actions that support vulnerable populations, promote sustainable livelihoods, and strengthen environmental monitoring systems, all of which are essential components of climate adaptation.
